definition: Assigning each sampled rollout a learning signal relative to a baseline, which in the critic-free methods the sources use means comparing rollouts within a group. Both sources identify the same structural failure from opposite ends: when every rollout in a group receives the same reward the group-relative advantage is zero and the batch teaches nothing. One hits it on prompts where all rollouts are already correct, wasting the rollouts; the other on negative samples where no valid output exists, and forces a canonical 'None' rollout so the group regains variance. Together they show that group-relative methods depend on within-group disagreement, which makes example selection a requirement rather than an optimization.

evidence.note: Gives each retrieval step of a search agent a dense reward built from two ground-truth-conditioned signals — how much the step raised the model's likelihood of the correct answer, and how necessary the step looks in hindsight — and fuses them asymmetrically so that a step which helps locally but is redundant globally is discounted.
evidence.title: BiCAA: Bidirectional Credit Assignment for Search-Augmented Agent

evidence.note: Re-scores a search agent's own sampled tokens under a teacher that has been shown the instance's supporting evidence, and uses the detached teacher-student gap to nudge the GRPO advantage up or down on search and answer tokens only, without adding a distillation loss or changing anything at inference.
evidence.title: EviSD: Evidence-Conditioned Self-Distillation for Search-Augmented Agents

evidence.note: Estimates what a continuous latent thought is worth by freezing the context after it and averaging the rewards of several answers sampled from that fixed context, then credits latent positions with the resulting thought-level advantage and answer positions with the ordinary group-relative one.
evidence.title: Latent Thought Credit: Multi-Answer Credit Assignment for Latent Reasoning

evidence.note: Inserts a stage before RL in which the model extracts textual lessons from its own successful and failed rollouts, filters them by measured marginal utility on a held-out probe set, and distills the surviving pool into its own weights — so that GRPO starts from a policy that fails all-eight-samples less often.
evidence.title: Self-Improving Large Language Models via Progressive Experience Evolution

evidence.note: Treats a policy's per-problem failure probability as a random variable over the problem distribution and shows that REINFORCE, pass@K training and MaxRL each optimize a single moment of it, then proposes minimizing the first T moments jointly — which is exactly minimizing the expected truncated number of rollouts needed to reach a first success.
evidence.title: Beyond the Mean: Multi-Moment Policy Optimization for LLM Reasoning

evidence.note: Replaces PPO's scalar mean-squared-error critic head with a categorical predictor over a discretized value support trained by cross-entropy against Gaussian-smoothed targets, decodes it back to a scalar for an unchanged GAE update, and shows the resulting critic is better calibrated and produces near-symmetric advantages where the MSE critic penalizes failures two-to-three times harder than it rewards successes.
evidence.title: Start Classifying: Categorical Critics for LLM Reinforcement Learning

evidence.note: Supervises audio reasoning with per-question rubrics generated from the raw waveform, and keeps the signal alive as the policy improves by regenerating the rubrics from the model's own rollouts each step and pruning any criterion that every rollout satisfies or none does.
evidence.title: Reinforcement Learning with Evolving Rubrics as Rewards for Audio Reasoning

evidence.note: Scores each reasoning step of a translation by how much appending it raises a frozen reference model's teacher-forced likelihood of the gold translation, and adds that as a dense per-step reward on top of sequence-level quality — after first establishing that explicit reasoning helps long and hard inputs while drifting on terminology and style.
evidence.title: PAMT: Process-Aligned Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Domain Machine Translation

evidence.note: Shows that GRPO's per-completion uniformity is frequency-skewed once credit is aggregated by solution structure — a recurring correct form accumulates positive coefficient mass proportional to how often it is sampled — and rebalances it by a rarity exponent over a partition built from deterministic cue signatures rather than a judge model.
evidence.title: When Correct Solutions Repeat: Rarity-Aware Credit Redistribution for GRPO

evidence.note: A GRPO variant that teaches multimodal models to refuse when a referred object is absent, without losing localization accuracy on cases where it is present.
evidence.title: Teaching MLLMs to Say No: Generalized Referring Expression Comprehension via Refusal Calibrated GRPO

evidence.note: Addresses wasted rollouts in critic-free RL on prompts where every sampled rollout is already correct and the advantage estimate is therefore zero.
evidence.title: Miner: Mining Intrinsic Mastery for Data-Efficient RL in Large Reasoning Models

name: advantage estimation
